comments.text:
Claude's built for deep, context-aware reasoning in its own ecosystem—Anthropic tunes it that way to balance quality and safety. NotebookLM is Google's separate tool for turning notes into summaries or audio overviews, so the hack works by offloading long context there to stretch tokens.

No conspiracy on burning through limits; it's just how isolated AI platforms are designed. Cross-company auto-integration would need partnerships they haven't pursued. Smart users like you stitch them together manually for the win.

comments.text:
if you're using o1 or claude 3.5 for the entire loop you're burning money for no reason. 

the move is using the reasoning model for the initial plan and the final synthesis pass only. for the intermediate tool calls and observation parsing, small models like gemini 1.5 flash or llama 3.2 3b are more than enough. a good coordinator agent can handle 90% of the heavy lifting using models that cost 1/10th the price.
